title: Finite scoped spatial-query compounds with whole-design truth conditions
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED, NOT SELECTED. Finite spatial-query compounds whose modifier scope is checked against a whole independently coded design. This is a declarative query/evaluation contract, not a freely generated causal graph or another drawing-operation list. Exact bounded code family and complete source-only counterexample included; no target fit or historical writing-format claim.

design.structural_link: Directed primitive composition defines each whole group as one partial semantic transformer; its action depends on entry state or typed evaluation stack. This creates exact whole-sequence interactions without a per-word sense table. It is a prospective explanation to test, not an established explanation of GDT608 whole-form residuals. Spaces delimit composition blocks and are never deleted.

writing_family.alphabet: lowercase Latin transcription characters a through z, literally; no case normalization or token deletion
writing_family.key: One injective prefix-free map from the declared semantic atom inventory to strings of length1..3. The same key is used in every complete account. No per-word/per-position key or post-target extension.
writing_family.group: Concatenation of1..3 complete atom codewords, parsed uniquely. Arbitrary grouping among those legal blocks is part of the declared finite family; no atom crosses a space.
writing_family.surface_consequences: Every group has1..9 literal characters; every character is consumed; every group is a composition of at most3 inventory atoms. These hard necessary conditions are prospective, not checked on target data. They may fail immediately.
writing_family.limits: Bounds are explicit modern model choices, not historically licensed field counts. There is no fixed total word count or universal ENTRY prefix.

design.testing: First source-only exhaustive bounded programs and deliberately wrong-semantics controls; then a separately registered complete-target capacity/fit test only if selected. A syntactically valid parse alone is not semantic evidence. No target test is selected here.
design.failures: GDT885 rules out its fixed reversible common-endpoint three-state class; these are fixed noninvertible partial maps or typed queries, not that class. GDT903 unrestricted automaton compatibility cannot justify either fixed semantic inventory. GDT616 original contract remains failed. R1/R2 and GDT969 remain closed; no alphabet/width/bound repair after an outcome. GDT949 semantic-discriminator stop is retained from parent notification, not claimed independently read in this bounded draft.
design.access: No raw target input, target image, reserve, new admission or contact. Existing source ownership and predecessor metadata/reports only.
design.mechanism: Finite spatial-query compounds whose modifier scope is checked against a whole independently coded design. This is a declarative query/evaluation contract, not a freely generated causal graph or another drawing-operation list.

design.semantic_projection: A declared restricted color-and-containment description, not the whole historical blazon: lion attitude, exact brushstrokes and explanatory social text are outside this language. Powdering treats roundels as one collective object; their exact count/locations are not encoded or inferred.

atoms.PARENT: replace top set by union of parents; root has no parent
atoms.EQ: pop two sets and require exact equality
atoms.NE: pop one set and require nonempty

design.grammar: Each query starts with one selector then0..3 unary operations. Each assertion is query NE or query query EQ. A complete account has1..8 assertions, empty stack between assertions and at end, and includes every declared node selector somewhere. The writing-family group boundaries may divide or combine query fragments, but every group still has1..3 whole atom codes. No stack underflow, ignored atom or free synonym is allowed.
design.different_rival: PARENT after GOLD on ROUND yields the black border. GOLD after PARENT on ROUND yields empty. Thus ROUND GOLD PARENT BORDER EQ is true, while ROUND PARENT GOLD BORDER EQ is false under the same code and scene. Both use exactly the same atoms, so a short-fragment or bag-of-atoms match cannot decide the assertion. Moving powdering from border to field likewise falsifies its complete ownership assertion.
design.needed_data: Independently specified whole design nodes, parent relations and colors, with all ambiguities retained; complete text ownership and one global code across further examples. A scene inferred freely from the same text is not independent evidence. No admitted Voynich shield is nominated; this is an exact source/control writing candidate only.
design.whole_form_limit: The order-dependent query transformer can produce a whole-form interaction; it does not license arbitrary lexical exceptions or prove the measured whole-form residual has this origin.
design.closest_predecessors: IDEA111 reviewed metadata already covers generic drawing operations; original missing finite rule and endpoint remain. This candidate supplies a finite observational query semantics rather than claiming those gates passed. IDEA348 already owns causal apparatus graphs and is not reused. Direct primary review of GDT879/881/346 remains required before scientific selection; this is deliberately raw retention.
design.novelty_limit: Finite query/code realization and same-atom opposite-order truth contrast are supplied. Historical writing format and target relevance are unestablished. Color permutations and simultaneous referent renaming remain gauges unless independent observations bind them.
